event.summary: Rachel moves a tissue packet from an otherwise empty table and sits down just as Mr Lim returns carrying his food.

evidence.quote: Excuse me, ma'am — I left that tissue packet to chope this seat before I went to buy food.

I didn’t realise you were saving the seat. I only saw a small tissue packet and no tray, so I thought the table was free; I moved the packet to the side rather than take it. I can either hand the packet back or move my bag and make space so you can sit.
Mr Lim — would you prefer Rachel to hand the tissue packet back, or would you rather she move her bag and make space so you can sit? Either way okay lah; no need make big thing.
Mr Lim, maybe the easiest is Rachel move her bag and make space for you. If you'd rather keep the chope, Rachel can hand the tissue packet back — your choice.
Okay lah, good suggestion Arjun. Rachel, can you please move your bag a bit so I can sit? ... If you rather, you can hand the packet back also — either one fine, no need make big thing.
Okay, I'll move my bag now — please go ahead and sit.
Thanks Rachel, really appreciate you sorting this quickly. Mr Lim, please go ahead and sit — tray already there. No need make big thing, enjoy your lunch.
All settled — enjoy your lunch, everyone.
